newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to float 20 pct in Imiter silver mine.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to float 20 pct in Imiter silver mine.

text.p: Morocco's privatisation ministry said on Wednesday it would float on the stock exchange 20 percent from its minority stake in Imiter silver mine, worth 650 million dirhams ($68.4 million), in May.
"During the flotation of Imiter firm on the Casablanca stock exchange, priority will be given, as usual, to privatisation bond shareholders," an official said.
Date and details of the privatisation proceedings were not immediately known, the official said.

The state holds a stake of 33 percent of Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter (SMI) through the state-run Bureau des Recherches et Participations Minieres (BRPM). The rest is held by Morocco's largest private holding ONA group.
Established in 1929, Casablanca bourse has 47 listed stocks including lead mining firm Zellidja.
